name: Seraphic Luxion
source:
Three beautiful girls gain superpowers of different elements with the the help of mysterious substance of "Penjuram" that triggers with strong human emotions. The power can be refined with sex and especially insults. In search of "Penjuram" power deformed monsters start to appear at the school attacking students.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
三位美丽的女孩在引发强烈人类情感的神秘物质“Penjuram”的帮助下获得了不同元素的超能力。这种力量可以通过性，尤其是侮辱来提升。为了寻找“Penjuram”力量，变形怪物开始出现在学校攻击学生。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
